_doc: PATHFINDER-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-21): there are always several paths and the information is usually already held. An owner ask (needs-you item, open-loops gate, /owner link, 'needs Rowan' message) is allowed only with an exhaustion proof: at least one recorded attempt in every surface class below, or a stated reason that class does not apply. Lesson: a Bluesky post sat 'blocked' for a day on an owner click while reverting a client-type change restored the existing session, and an idle sibling Worker already held working logins. Consumers: foundation/pathfinder.py (--check in checks.yml via openloops, --resolve, --regress), detector pathfinder-exhaustion, tests/foundation/test_pathfinder.py.

surface_classes.existing-credentials: a token, session or secret already bound anywhere in Ultrastable, the quniverse account, GitHub secrets or a sibling Worker
surface_classes.prior-working-config: git history or a recorded deploy in which the integration worked; revert or diff the change that broke it
surface_classes.sibling-workers: another Worker, repository or agent that already does the same job or holds the same authority
surface_classes.alternate-channel: a different route to the same outcome (another API, protocol, account, relay or workflow)
surface_classes.construct: build the missing capability from primitives

route_kinds: git:PATH (a commit touched PATH, so a prior config exists)
